summary_1line: Arjuna is honored in Indra’s heaven, receives celestial weapons, lives there five years learning arts, yet remains restless remembering his family and injustices.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra embraces Arjuna and seats him beside himself on the divine throne beneath a white umbrella as gods and Gandharvas sing around them.
Thousands of Apsaras like Menaka and Urvasi dance in Indra’s court while celestial musicians play as Arjuna watches among the gods.
Arjuna stands in the radiant court of heaven receiving celestial weapons from Indra amid clouds, lightning, and gathered deities.
